title: MOBILE TRUTH — Factory Twin Semantic Parity
promise: A phone renders fewer objects, never less truth: every FactoryTwin machine, route, and active work order remains discoverable and inspectable from the same semantic snapshot.
stakes: Today the Hall slices machines, routes, and WIP before the mobile experience can inspect them. That is a performance optimization leaking into meaning. DT-06 must make density a visual concern only.
click: On a 390px phone the Citadel stays light—24 machines, 36 routes, 12 WIP drawn—but the ≡ FACTORY TRUTH index still exposes the exact same semantic entity IDs as a 1440px desktop.

source_of_truth.rule: Renderer may omit geometry for density. It may not omit an entity from semantic discovery or invent an entity absent from FactoryTwinSnapshot.

value_rationale.compact_width_px: Preserves the Hall's current JS mobile threshold exactly; CSS moves from 680 to 720 so one number defines the compact experience.
value_rationale.machine_visual_cap: Preserves current low/full geometry budgets (24/72). The change is where slicing occurs: after semantic catalog construction.
value_rationale.semantic_index_initial_rows: 80 keeps initial DOM work bounded while search operates over the full catalog before row slicing; no entity becomes unreachable.
value_rationale.touch_target_min_px: Matches existing Hall controls and Beam touch law.
value_rationale.semantic_index_mobile_geometry: 96px top clears the 44px top controls plus zone label; 154px bottom clears the two-row 93px move pad at its current 52px bottom offset with a 9px safety gap.

parts.name: View policy constants
parts.role: Move all mobile/full density numbers into one immutable local data object; no new platform service.

parts.name: Semantic entity sets
parts.role: Capture full Twin machines/routes/active work orders before any render slicing.

parts.name: Visual slices
parts.role: Apply existing 24/72, 36/120, 12/32 limits only to geometry.

parts.name: Factory Truth index
parts.role: Compact searchable access to every semantic entity, including those not drawn.

parts.name: Parity observability
parts.role: Expose read-only semantic/drawn counts and IDs for verification; never authority.

parts.name: Parity verifier
parts.role: Prove desktop/mobile semantic ID equality and visual-only density differences.

build_steps.title: Centralize the existing density data — do not invent a second mobile system
build_steps.done_state: No literal 24/72, 36/120, 12/32, 64/128, 1.2/1.8 remains in render-selection expressions outside VIEW.
build_steps.verification: Static test asserts VIEW contains all locked values and old ad-hoc low ternaries for these budgets are absent.

build_steps.title: Create full semantic sets before slicing geometry
build_steps.done_state: Full machine and route sets exist independently from visibleFactory/visibleRoutes.
build_steps.verification: Synthetic Twin with >visual caps yields semantic counts greater than drawn counts while all semantic IDs remain retained.

build_steps.title: Make active work orders semantic-first too
build_steps.invariant: RELEASED remains excluded from the active-WIP semantic set because the existing floor contract is active work, not archive history.
build_steps.done_state: Visual WIP budget cannot delete active work from semantic discovery.
build_steps.verification: A 40-WIP synthetic snapshot draws at most 12 on low profile but the semantic index contains all 40.

build_steps.title: Add one compact ≡ FACTORY TRUTH door
build_steps.anchor_exact: <button class="btn word" id="refinery">REFINERY</button><button class="btn icon" id="sound"
build_steps.insert_exact: <button class="btn word" id="refinery">REFINERY</button><button class="btn icon" id="semantic-index-toggle" title="Factory semantic index" aria-label="Open factory semantic index" aria-expanded="false">≡</button><button class="btn icon" id="sound"
panel_insert_before: <input id="semantic-search" type="search" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Find machine, route, work order…" aria-label="Search factory truth">
build_steps.done_state: One 44px icon exposes all semantic entities without adding another app, page, or authority path.
build_steps.verification: DOM test requires toggle, index, search, list, count, and aria-expanded/aria-hidden state.

build_steps.title: Build the searchable catalog from the full Twin sets, not the visual slices
build_steps.helper_rule: Extract the existing inline machine and work-order pick-node object creation into factoryInspectNode(n) and workInspectNode(o) so geometry clicks and index clicks invoke identical inspect() payloads.

search_contract.ordering: filter full catalog first, then slice(0,80)
search_contract.overflow_text: Show '<visible> of <matches> · type to narrow' when matches > 80

build_steps.done_state: A visually omitted entity is still searchable by exact entity_id and opens the same inspector as a rendered entity.
build_steps.verification: Test asserts catalog construction references semanticFactory/semanticRoutes/semanticWip and never visibleFactory/visibleRoutes/visibleWip.

build_steps.title: Make the index physically phone-safe and align the breakpoint
build_steps.geometry_proof: Existing move pad is 93px tall and starts 52px above the safe-area baseline; its top is 145px. A 154px sheet bottom leaves 9px separation.
build_steps.done_state: Phone index never covers movement controls, uses one shared 720px breakpoint, and every interactive row is at least 44px.
build_steps.verification: Computed-style/browser assertion: semantic rows/search/toggle >=44px; at 390x844 portrait and 844x390 landscape the sheet bounding box does not intersect move-pad/use.

build_steps.title: Keep resize responsive without pretending geometry was rebuilt
build_steps.honesty_boundary: Do not claim the already-instantiated scene increases object count after an orientation change. DT-06 guarantees semantic parity continuously and responsive UI/DPR continuously; visual object budget is selected at scene construction until a future scene-rebuild feature exists.
build_steps.done_state: Resize updates layout/camera/DPR truthfully; no false claim of live geometry repopulation.
build_steps.verification: Blueprint verifier asserts this non-goal exists and runtime tests compare semantic IDs, not geometry count, across resize.

build_steps.title: Wire the index to the existing inspector — no second detail system
required_behavior: semantic-search input rerenders rows from the full semanticCatalog.
Clicking .semantic-row calls inspect(row.node), closes the semantic index, and leaves #info as the only detail panel.
Escape closes the semantic index if open; it does not alter camera or Funnel state.
Invalid Twin leaves semanticCatalog empty and index count '0 entities'; existing TWIN INVALID remains visible.
build_steps.done_state: Index navigation is merely another input into inspect(n).
build_steps.verification: Source test forbids a second machine/work-order detail renderer and checks row click path contains inspect(row.node).

build_steps.title: Add independent semantic-parity verification
exact_assertions: VIEW.compactWidth === 720; machine caps 24/72; route caps 36/120; WIP caps 12/32; DPR caps 1.2/1.8; ring segments 64/128.
semanticFactory, semanticRoutes, semanticWip are created from validated Twin arrays before any .slice visual cap.
FACTORY_TWIN_VIEW_STATE.semantic_ids derives from semanticCatalog, not visible arrays.
A synthetic Twin with 100 machines + 50 routes + 40 active WIP yields identical semantic ID sets for low and full policies.
Low drawn counts <= 24/36/12; full drawn counts <= 72/120/32.
A semantic ID outside the low visual cap can be found by exact search and routed to inspect().
Existing TWIN INVALID source assertion remains.
No DT-06 blueprint link targets blueprint-dt06-mobile-parity.html directly; canonical owner link is pulse-dashboard.html?tool=blueprintdt06.
build_steps.done_state: Parity is mechanically checked; 'mobile safe' is not a prose claim.

interfaces.contract: Validated snapshot arrays are copied/read, never mutated.
Only rendering applies caps; semantic sets remain complete.
Full searchable set; 80-row DOM cap applies after search filtering.
Use same inspect payload helpers as 3D pickables.
720 and density budgets are the only canonical DT-06 presentation values.

acceptance: Phone and desktop expose identical semantic entity ID sets for the same FactoryTwinSnapshot.
Phone may draw fewer machines/routes/WIP but every omitted entity remains searchable and inspectable.
Invalid Twin never produces optimistic catalog entities.
No new authority, data source, app, route, or standalone navigation path is introduced.
All DT-06 links presented to the owner use pulse-dashboard.html?tool=blueprintdt06.
A competent builder can implement every change from this blueprint without choosing new numeric values or asking how the parts connect.
non_goals: Do not change Funnel authority, work-order semantics, health semantics, machine lifecycle, or route semantics.
Do not rebuild the 3D scene when orientation changes; semantic parity and UI responsiveness are the DT-06 guarantee.
Do not add server state, sync, new storage, or a second inspector.
Do not raise mobile visual caps beyond the existing 24/36/12 budgets.
Do not hide TWIN INVALID or substitute raw plant/factory data when Twin validation fails.

pulse_registration.owner_navigation_rule: All visible blueprint cross-links target _top Pulse dashboard deep links.

preflight: if an anchor changed, stop and re-run the blueprint through the Funnel instead of guessing
